outcome: Obstetric complications (urinary tract infections, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, gestational diabetes, fetal malformations, intrauterine fetal death, intrauterine growth restriction, intrauterine discordant growth)
cohort: 25 induced and 157 spontaneously conceived twin pregnancies at a tertiary obstetric center over a 16-year period
finding: The mode of conception did not significantly influence most obstetric and neonatal outcomes in twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was higher in induced gestations (64%) compared to spontaneous gestations (52.2%).
